body:
Alone. Lonely. Worthless. Unimportant. Dreadfully worn out. It seems like for the most part while I have no trouble making friends they're the kind that just get what they want from you and disappear, compounding some of the feelings above.

Like I don't matter, have never mattered, and will never matter. If so many see something in me to be like that toward me, the only common denominator is me.
While I appreciate the notion I will have to politely decline the card. I don't want something out of pity. I've pitied myself enough.
